entries.claim: Chiliz issues ERC-20 fan tokens for sports clubs, distributed via the Socios.com fan-engagement app.
entries.source_ref: Official Chiliz/Socios product documentation and press

entries.claim: Named fan tokens exist for clubs including FC Barcelona ($BAR), Paris Saint-Germain ($PSG), Manchester City ($CITY) and UFC ($UFC).
entries.source_ref: Public token listings / press; contract addresses NOT captured

entries.claim: Fan tokens are primary-issued through Fan Token Offerings (FTO) priced in the native token $CHZ.
Chiliz Chain is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 for sports/entertainment tokens, with migration from legacy/Ethereum-based deployment.
$CHZ is the native token and is listed on major centralised exchanges.
Token holders receive club polls, rewards and token-gated experiences ("locker room" style perks).
Chiliz was founded by Alexandre Dreyfus and is rooted in Malta (EU), with Hungarian origins.
As an EU-based crypto-asset issuer, Chiliz is exposed to MiCA, which governs non-ART/EMT crypto-asset issuance and services.
entries.source_ref: EU MiCA regulation (public); specific token classification INFERRED

entries.claim: Chiliz/Socios is a private entity; audited group financial statements are not publicly filed.
entries.source_ref: Absence of public filings (private MD/MT entity) — officer/comp data UNKNOWN

entries.claim: The Socios.com client delivery model (native vs RN vs webview) and embedded-wallet custody are not determinable without an artefact.
Fan-token contract addresses, Chiliz Chain validator/bridge contracts and any TVL/user counts are not stated and require explorer + contract verification.
entries.source_ref: Requires Chiliz Chain explorer + contract verification; never to be fabricated

entries.claim: The two-token flywheel (fiat -> $CHZ -> club token -> engagement) is a synthesised model, not observed code; voting-power weighting is server-side.
